Emmvee Energy Private Limited (Unit-5) | website = {{URL|https://emmvee.com/}} }} '''Emmvee Group''' is an Indian renewable energy company with its headquarters in [[Bangalore|Bengaluru]], [[Karnataka]], that manufactures solar [[Photovoltaics|photovoltaic]] (PV) modules and solar cells through its subsidiaries.{{cite report |url=https://www.sbisecurities.in/fileserver/research/reports/Emmvee%20Photovoltaic%20Power%20Ltd_IPO%20Note.pdf |title=Emmvee Photovoltaic Power Ltd. |date=7 November 2025 |publisher=SBI Securities |access-date=15 July 2026}}{{Cite web |last=Bagade |first=Hrithik Kiran |date=2025-04-22 |title=Emmvee eyes Rs 2,500 crore revenues, opens new plant |url=https://www.newindianexpress.com/business/2025/Apr/22/emmvee-eyes-rs-2500-crore-revenues-opens-new-plant |access-date= |website=The New Indian Express |language=en}} Its subsidiary, Emmvee Photovoltaic Power Limited (formerly Emmvee Photovoltaic Power Private Limited),{{Cite web |title=DV Manjunatha, Founder & Managing Director of Emmvee Group |url=https://www.theceomagazine.com/executive-interviews/utilities-energy/indias-solar-superstar-dv-manjunatha/ |access-date=2025-04-28 |website=The CEO Magazine |language=en-US}}{{Cite web |title=Report on Industrial visit to EMMVEE Photovoltaic Power Private Limited |url=https://www.reva.edu.in/events/report-on-industrial-visit-to-emmvee-photovoltaic-power-private-limited-491 |website=[[Reva University]]}} listed on the [[Bombay Stock Exchange|BSE]] and [[National Stock Exchange of India|NSE]] on 18 November 2025 following an [[initial public offering]]. == History == D. V. Manjunatha founded Emmvee Group in 1992,{{Cite web |last=Kumar |first=Venkatesha Babu & Aishwarya |date=2025-04-18 |title=US–China tariff war may benefit Indian solar firms, says Emmvee |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/uschina-tariff-war-may-benefit-indian-solar-firms-says-emmvee/article69464168.ece |access-date=2025-05-01 |website=BusinessLine |language=en}} initially manufacturing thermal products before the company expanded into solar water heating systems.{{Cite web |last=Kochuveedan |first=Benn |date=2026-06-07 |title=Emmvee evaluating diversification into polysilicon, ingots, wafers as part of backward integration plans |url=https://www.newindianexpress.com/business/2026/Jun/07/emmvee-evaluating-diversification-into-polysilicon-ingots-wafers-as-part-of-backward-integration-plans |access-date=2026-07-15 |website=The New Indian Express |language=en}} It moved into solar PV module manufacturing in 2006, and the following year established Emmvee Photovoltaic Private Limited in Bengaluru with an initial capacity of 15 MW.{{Cite web |last=Goyal |first=Khushboo |date=2022-07-27 |title=Emmvee: Expanding its solar module manufacturing capacity |url=https://renewablewatch.in/2022/07/27/emmvee/ |access-date= |website=Renewable Watch |language=en-US}} That capacity reached 500 MW by 2017 and roughly 4.6 GW by 2024.{{Cite web |last= |title=Emmvee expands solar manufacturing capacity with new facility in Karnataka - ET Manufacturing |url=https://manufacturing.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/energy/emmvee-expands-solar-manufacturing-capacity-with-new-facility-in-karnataka/120377382 |access-date=2025-04-28 |website=ETManufacturing.in |language=en}} The company opened an additional 0.75 GW facility in 2022 and, in the same year, sold two solar power projects totaling 55 MW to O2 Power.{{Cite web |last=Mishra |first=Gaourav |title=O2 Power Acquires 55 MW of Solar Projects from Emmvee Group - Mercom India |url=https://www.mercomindia.com/o2-power-acquires-55-mw-solar-projects-emmvee-group |access-date=2025-05-01 |website=Mercomindia.com}}{{cite report |url=https://www.icicidirect.com/mailcontent/idirect_emmveephotovoltaicpowerltd._iporeview_nov25.pdf |title=Emmvee Photovoltaic Power Ltd. IPO Note |date=10 November 2025 |publisher=ICICI Direct |access-date=15 July 2026}} A research collaboration with [[Fraunhofer Institute for Solar Energy Systems|Fraunhofer ISE]], a German solar-energy research institute, began in February 2023 to develop high-efficiency [[TOPCon]] cell technology.{{Cite web |last=Gupta |first=Uma |date=2023-02-13 |title=Emmvee gets Fraunhofer ISE on board for solar cell line |url=https://www.pv-magazine-india.com/2023/02/13/emmvee-gets-fraunhofer-ise-on-board-for-solar-cell-line/ |access-date= |website=pv magazine India |language=en-US}} By 2024, the company had commissioned a TOPCon solar cell manufacturing line with a capacity of approximately 2.5–2.94 GW.{{Cite web |last=Sharma |first=Jatin |date=2024-02-21 |title=Emmvee to start TOPCon solar cell production from June |url=https://www.pv-magazine-india.com/2024/02/21/emmvee-to-start-topcon-solar-cell-production-from-june/ |access-date=2025-04-28 |website=pv magazine India |language=en-US}}{{cite report |url=https://bsmedia.business-standard.com/_media/bs/data/market-reports/equity-brokertips/2026-04/17774444960.99046200.pdf |title=Emmvee Photovoltaic Power |last= |first= |date=April 2026 |publisher=JM Financial |location=Mumbai |access-date=15 July 2026 |type=Equity Research Report}} The company said it was the only Indian manufacturer, and one of four worldwide, to pass all tests under Kiwa PVEL's Product Qualification Program for a single product type that year.{{Cite web |date=2024-06-08 |title=Emmvee leads in all categories of Kiwa PVEL PQP Testing |url=https://www.pv-magazine-india.com/2024/06/08/emmvee-leads-in-all-categories-of-kiwa-pvel-pqp-testing/ |access-date=2025-04-28 |website=pv magazine India |language=en-US}}{{Cite book |last=Ravindra |first=N. M. |url=https://iopscience.iop.org/book/mono/978-0-7503-5994-8.pdf |title=Recent Advances in Solar Cells |last2=Lin |first2=Leqi |last3=Singh |first3=Priyanka |date=2025-03-01 |publisher=IOP Publishing |isbn=978-0-7503-5994-8 |language=en}} === Initial public offering === Emmvee Photovoltaic Power Limited's initial public offering ran from 11 to 13 November 2025, raising a total issue size of ₹2,900 crore (US$300 million) at a price band of ₹206 (US$2.20) per share.{{Cite news |last=Presswala |first=Ritesh |date=2025-11-13 |title=Emmvee Photovoltaic Power IPO final day: Subscription below 60%, GMP slips. Should you invest? |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/ipos/fpos/emmvee-photovoltaic-power-ipo-day-3-falling-gmp-weak-subscription-should-you-bid/articleshow/125289560.cms |access-date=2026-07-15 |work=The Economic Times |issn=0013-0389}} At the time of the offering, the company described itself as the second-largest pure-play integrated solar PV module and cell manufacturer in India by production capacity as of March 2025, with module capacity of 7.80 GW and cell capacity of 2.94 GW as of 31 May 2025.{{cite report |url=https://www.chittorgarh.net/reports/ipo_notes/smc-global-ltd__emmvee-photovoltaic-power_-ipo-note_neutral.pdf |title=Emmvee Photovoltaic Power Limited |author= |date=November 2025 |publisher=SMC Global Securities Ltd. |location=New Delhi |access-date=15 July 2026 |type=IPO Research Report}} == Operations and manufacturing == As of 31 March 2026, the company reported an aggregate installed manufacturing capacity of approximately 10.3 GW for solar PV modules, following a transition to TOPCon technology, and 2.94 GW for solar cells, across facilities in Karnataka.{{Cite web |last=Gupta |first=Uma |date=2026-04-28 |title=Emmvee reports INR 5,050 crore revenue, INR 1,082 crore profit in FY2026 |url=https://www.pv-magazine-india.com/2026/04/28/emmvee-posts-inr-5050-crore-revenue-inr-1082-crore-profit-in-fy2026/ |access-date=2026-07-15 |website=pv magazine India |language=en-IN}} During FY2026, the company commissioned two additional 2.5 GW module manufacturing lines at [[Sulibele]], [[Hoskote|Hoskote Taluk]], Bengaluru, in May and December 2025.{{Cite web |last=India |first=Energética |date=2025-12-22 |title=Emmvee Commissions 2.5 GW Solar Module Line in Karnataka, Total Capacity Reaches 10.3 GW - Asia Pacific {{!}} Energetica India Magazine |url=https://www.energetica-india.net/news/emmvee-commissions-2500-mw-solar-module-line-in-karnataka |access-date=2026-07-15 |website=Energetica India Magazine |language=en}}{{Cite web |last=Gupta |first=Uma |date=2025-12-22 |title=Emmvee starts production at 2.5 GW solar module line in Karnataka |url=https://www.pv-magazine-india.com/2025/12/22/emmvee-start-production-at-2-5-gw-solar-module-line-in-karnataka/ |access-date=2026-07-15 |website=pv magazine India |language=en-IN}} The company has announced plans for a further 6 GW integrated cell-and-module manufacturing facility at [[Devanahalli|Devanahalli, Bengaluru]], targeting total installed capacity of 16.3 GW for modules and 8.9–8.94 GW for cells by FY2028. The [[Indian Renewable Energy Development Agency]] (IREDA) has sanctioned a term loan toward this expansion. == Projects and partnerships == Emmvee has built a 1 MW rooftop solar installation at [[Cochin International Airport]] and a 40 MW ground-mounted solar plant spanning Karnataka's Bagepalli, Kunigal, and Bidar districts.{{Cite news |last=U N |first=Sushma |date=2013-05-29 |title=Emmvee Photovoltaic Power, a solar module manufacturer and turnkey solution provider, will be setting up a 1 MW rooftop grid-connected solar power system at Cochin International Airport. The plant is expected to be commissioned by 15th August 2013. |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/emmvee-photovoltaic-power-a-solar-module-manufacturer-and-turnkey-solution-provider-will-be-setting-up-a-1-mw-rooftop-grid-connected-solar-power-system-at-cochin-international-airport-the-plant-is-expected-to-be-commissioned-by-15th-august-2013-/articleshow/20326750.cms |access-date= |work=The Times of India |issn=0971-8257}} In June 2024, NTPC Renewable Energy Ltd. placed a 795.4 MWp TOPCon module supply order with the company for the Khavda solar project in Gujarat.{{Cite web |date=2024-06-14 |title=Emmvee secures 795.4 MWp TOPCon DCR module supply order for NTPC Khavda project |url=https://www.pv-magazine-india.com/2024/06/14/emmvee-secures-795-4-mwp-topcon-dcr-module-supply-order-for-ntpc-khavda-project/ |access-date= |website=pv magazine India |language=en-US}} == Awards and recognition == * National Award by the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE){{Cite web |title=Ministry of New and Renewable Energy Celebrates Silver Jubilee |url=https://www.pib.gov.in/newsite/erelcontent.aspx?relid=33028®=48&lang=2 |website=Ministry of New and Renewable Energy22}}{{Cite web |title=India: Ministry Presents Awards to Eight Solar Thermal Manufacturers |url=https://solarthermalworld.org/news/india-ministry-presents-awards-eight-solar-thermal-manufacturers/ |access-date=2026-07-15 |website=Solarthermalworld |language=en-US}} == See also == * [[Solar power in India]] * [[Renewable energy in India]] == References == {{reflist}} [[Category:Indian companies established in 1992]]
extract: Emmvee Group is an Indian renewable energy company with its headquarters in Bengaluru, Karnataka, that manufactures solar photovoltaic (PV) modules and solar cells through its subsidiaries. Its subsidiary, Emmvee Photovoltaic Power Limited (formerly Emmvee Photovoltaic Power Private Limited), listed on the BSE and NSE on 18 November 2025 following an initial public offering.
